shellCommands.command: for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js next.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo "===== $f"; cat "$f"; done
git ls-files && git diff -- package.json && test -d node_modules && echo node_modules-present || true; test -f next-env.d.ts && cat next-env.d.ts || true

rm pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/index.js pages/blog/'[id].js' pages/blog/index.js pages/api/posts/'[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js components/AppProvider.js && rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npx tsc --noEmit

set -e
for path in / /blog /blog/1 /blog/999999 /api/posts /api/posts/1; do curl -s -o /tmp/fx-response -w "$path %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3100$path"; done
curl -s -o /tmp/fx-response -w 'POST /api/posts %{http_code}\n' -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Test","content":"Text"}' http://localhost:3100/api/posts
curl -s -o /tmp/fx-response -w 'PUT /api/posts/1 %{http_code}\n' -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Updated"}' http://localhost:3100/api/posts/1
curl -s -o /tmp/fx-response -w 'DELETE /api/posts/1 %{http_code}\n' -X DELETE http://localhost:3100/api/posts/1
curl -s -D /tmp/fx-headers -o /tmp/fx-response -w 'PATCH /api/posts/1 %{http_code}\n' -X PATCH http://localhost:3100/api/posts/1
cat /tmp/fx-headers
curl -s http://localhost:3100/blog/999999 | head -c 1100; echo; git status --short; git diff -- tsconfig.json; test -d pages && echo 'pages still exists' || echo 'pages removed'
npm run build >/tmp/fx-build.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -25 /tmp/fx-build.log; exit "$result"
for path in /blog/999999 /blog/nope /blog/11 /missing; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$path %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3100$path"; done; npx tsc --noEmit; git status --short
npm run build >/tmp/fx-build.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -22 /tmp/fx-build.log; exit "$result"
for path in /blog/999999 /blog/nope /blog/11; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$path %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3100$path"; done
rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && test ! -d pages && echo 'pages directory absent' && git diff --check
